basic_details.job_title: SLUSI Senior System Analyst Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of the receipt of applications)

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in Computer Application or M.Sc. (Computer Science or Information Technology), or B.E./B.Tech (Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Technology, Computer Science and Engineering or Information Technology), plus five years' post-qualification experience in system analysis and software development; must be a serving officer meeting the deputation grade conditions.
qualification.details: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government, State Governments, UT Administrations, PSUs, Universities, recognised Research Institutions, Semi-Government or Autonomous bodies or Statutory Organisations; (A)(i) holding analogous posts on regular basis; or (ii) 5 years regular service in Pay Band-3 (Rs. 15600-39100) with Grade Pay Rs. 5400; or (iii) 6 years in Pay Band-2 (Rs. 9300-34800) with Grade Pay Rs. 4800; or (iv) 7 years in Pay Band-2 with Grade Pay Rs. 4600, or equivalent; (B)(a) Master's degree in Computer Application or M.Sc. (Computer Science or Information Technology); or B.E. or B.Tech (Computer Engineering or Computer Science or Computer Technology or Computer Science and Engineering or Information Technology) from a recognised University or Institute Experience: Five years post qualification experience in system analysis, design and development of software for offline and online (web base) using databases such as MS-SQL Server or Oracle and front-end technologies like MS.Net or Java Server Page or HTML or DHTML, Java Script etc. in a Government Office, PSU, Autonomous Body, Statutory Body or any recognised Institution Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of the receipt of applications) | Other conditions: | Only applications routed through proper channel will be considered Only officers who can be relieved immediately should apply Proforma states officers under Central/State Governments are eligible only for Absorption and non-Government organisation candidates only for Short Term Contract | Desirable: | Two years' experience in system administration and networking, remote sensing and Geographical Information System (GIS) and Digital Image Processing (DIP)

salary_details.pay_scale: Level-11 of the Pay Matrix (pre-revised Rs. 15600-39100 + Grade Pay 6600 in Pay Band-3); pay on deputation regulated as per DoPT guidelines

how_to_apply: Fill the bio-data in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-II, in duplicate.
Get the employer certificate at the end of the bio-data signed by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority.
Attach attested ACR/APAR photocopies for the last five years, Vigilance Clearance, Integrity and No Penalty certificates.
Route the application through proper channel to The Under Secretary, INM Division, Room No. 573-A, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi - 110001.
Send within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 17 January 2027.
important_instructions: Circular also available at https://agriwelfare.gov.in/offerings/vacancies and https://slusi.da.gov.in/vacancy/vacancies.html Contact: Under Secretary, Tel. 011-23381191, Email [email protected]

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers under the Central Government, State Governments, UT Administrations, PSUs, Universities, recognised Research Institutions, Semi-Government or Autonomous bodies or Statutory Organisations; (A)(i) holding analogous posts on regular basis; or (ii) 5 years regular service in Pay Band-3 (Rs. 15600-39100) with Grade Pay Rs. 5400; or (iii) 6 years in Pay Band-2 (Rs. 9300-34800) with Grade Pay Rs. 4800; or (iv) 7 years in Pay Band-2 with Grade Pay Rs. 4600, or equivalent; (B)(a) Master's degree in Computer Application or M.Sc. (Computer Science or Information Technology); or B.E. or B.Tech (Computer Engineering or Computer Science or Computer Technology or Computer Science and Engineering or Information Technology) from a recognised University or Institute Experience: Five years post qualification experience in system analysis, design and development of software for offline and online (web base) using databases such as MS-SQL Server or Oracle and front-end technologies like MS.Net or Java Server Page or HTML or DHTML, Java Script etc. in a Government Office, PSU, Autonomous Body, Statutory Body or any recognised Institution Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of the receipt of applications) Other conditions: Only applications routed through proper channel will be considered Only officers who can be relieved immediately should apply Proforma states officers under Central/State Governments are eligible only for Absorption and non-Government organisation candidates only for Short Term Contract Desirable: Two years' experience in system administration and networking, remote sensing and Geographical Information System (GIS) and Digital Image Processing (DIP)

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for SLUSI Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications or those without photocopies of ACRs for the last five years will not be entertained

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay of the officer selected on deputation will be regulated as per DoPT guidelines, as amended from time to time. Period of deputation four years, which may be extended as per the prevailing rules Deputation including period in another ex-cadre post immediately preceding shall ordinarily not exceed four years Once selected, the candidate will not be allowed to withdraw their name

content_sections.heading: How Will SLUSI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Information in the CV, supported by documents, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bio-data in duplicate as per proforma (Annexure-II) Photocopies of ACRs/APARs for last five years, each page attested by an officer not below Under Secretary Vigilance Clearance Certificate Integrity Certificate certified by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent No Penalty Certificate or statement of major/minor penalties in the last 10 years Employer certificate confirming particulars, qualifications and experience, at the end of the bio-data

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SLUSI Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SLUSI Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior System Analyst (SSA).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SLUSI Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II (Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae proforma) of this notice) and send it to The Under Secretary, INM Division, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Room No. 573-A, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi - 110001, by through proper channel, to reach by 17 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of the receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-11 of the Pay Matrix (pre-revised Rs. 15600-39100 + Grade Pay 6600 in Pay Band-3); pay on deputation regulated as per DoPT guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Computer Application or M.Sc. (Computer Science or Information Technology), or B.E./B.Tech (Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Technology, Computer Science and Engineering or Information Technology), plus five years' post-qualification experience in system analysis and software development; must be a serving officer meeting the deputation grade conditions.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only applications routed through proper channel will be considered. Only officers who can be relieved immediately should apply. Proforma states officers under Central/State Governments are eligible only for Absorption and non-Government organisation candidates only for Short Term Contract.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications or those without photocopies of ACRs for the last five years will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Information in the CV, supported by documents, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of deputation four years, which may be extended as per the prevailing rules. Deputation including period in another ex-cadre post immediately preceding shall ordinarily not exceed four years. Once selected, the candidate will not be allowed to withdraw their name.
